5.3.5.3       Replacing the DLG intermediate PCB

                 This is the procedure to replace the DLG intermediate PCB.

            CAUTION 5.12
            Do not loosen or remove the screws for the wedge slide, which are marked with red paint. If

5.3.5.4       Replacing the DLG motor

                  This is the procedure to replace the DLG motor.
              The DLG motor is supplied as part of a spares kit, comprising the motor, coupling, spacer and
                screws.

              1   Make sure that the linear accelerator is safe for Agility™ BLD maintenance.
              2   Disconnect the cable that connects the motor to the DLG intermediate PCB.
              3   Remove the four captive allen screws (7) that attaches the motor interface plate (6) to the
                DLG slide (see Figure 5.56).

                replaced then remove it with a long-nosed pliers.

              5   Loosen the two grub screws (3) on the motor coupling (4) by two turns. Do not remove the
                   grub screws completely.
              6   Remove the motor coupling (4) and spacer collar (8) from the motor shaft.
              7   Remove the four allen screws (5) that hold the motor (9) to the interface plate (6) and
                 remove the interface plate.
              8   Keep the screws of the interface plate.
              9   Attach the interface plate to the replacement motor.
              10   Install the new spacer collar and motor coupling to the replacement motor shaft. Make sure
                      that the shaft end is flush with the coupling.
              11  Align one coupling grub screw with the flat surface on the shaft. Make sure that the coupling
                   grub screw is at a right angle to the flat surface of the shaft.
              12  Tighten the four grub screws (1) on the shaft (see Figure 5.57).
